svg.title: 11 of 12 builds live, thesis accuracy 75.9%, 594 commits in 52 weeks
svg.desc: Three counters. 11 of the 12 builds on this page are live: 3 in production and 8 demos. Thesis accuracy 75.9% for the CNN + BiLSTM hybrid, against BiLSTM 73.5%, CNN 72.2% and LSTM 43.9%. 594 commits in the last 52 weeks.
